_comment: Trust material the unattended upgrade verifies release provenance against (road-to-an-update-that-installs-itself-only-when-it-is-safe D15). Pinned, never refreshed at run time: a candidate release can never choose the roots it is checked against. Read by src/scripts/_lib/sigstore_provenance.ts, which refuses when a file's sha256 differs from the one recorded here. Refresh by re-extracting both targets from a newer @sigstore/tuf seeds.json and updating source and digests together; until a release carries new material, an unattended run refuses anything signed under a rotated root and `agent-config upgrade` by hand still works.
